decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system fits the firm's core office and conference business and post-pandemic workplace demand, so it is likely to stay.
A chair family close to the established offer can be used across residential and contract projects, and premium firms keep such designer lines for many years.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with a higher risk of being cut, but they support the rug collection and cost little to keep.
An upholstered sofa by a renowned design studio is the firm's core upholstery business and typically has a long product life.
A high standing table serves the flexible workplace and lounge settings the firm is targeting, so it remains a useful part of the range.
The rug collection is presented as a flagship and extends the firm into complete interiors, so management will continue to develop it.
